senses.gloss: --the round arch of a temple where the images of गौरी and विनायक are enshrined. M. २६९. ३५, ५४-6.
--a class of Gandharvas originating from Vik- रान्त; famous for valour and liberality; had three daughters, each an originator of a गण. वा. ६९. १८. २०. २२.
--due to his curse लक्ष्मी (wealth) is not stationary. Br. IV. 7. १९. [page३-164+ २३]
--the name of a सम्हिता imparted by बाष्- kali to बालायनि and others. भा. XII. 6. ५९.
--a R. from the Vindhyas. Br. II. १६. ३३.
--eight times the measurement of Trasa- रेणु (s.v.). M. २५८. १७. [page३-206+ ३२]

(I)--a son of विरजा (the daughter of ऋक्ष) and Mahendra. Crowned king of किष्किन्द and ruled with सुग्रीव; wife तारा and son Angada: crossed the seas, van- quished रावण at पुष्कर, and agreed to be his ally on his request; performed Vedic यज्ञस्, learned in the Vedic lore; applauded by नारद;
1: Br. III. 7. २१४-48.
killed by राम.
2: भा. IX. १०. १२; Vi. IV. 4. ९६.
(II)--an Asura in the सभा of हिरण्यकशिपु. M. १६१. ८१.
(III)--an अवतार् of the Lord in the १३थ् dva1para in the वालखिल्याश्रम of the गन्धमादन with तपस्विन् sons. वा. २३. १५९.
--a R. of the भारत vars2a. वा. ४५. १००.

(I)--originally born out of an ant-hill, born again of चर्षणी and वरुण. In his आश्रम, शीता was left when pregnant. There she gave birth to two sons whom the sage brought up;
1: भा. VI. १८. 5; IX. ११. १०-11, १५; Br. III. ३६. 6.
author of राम's story; of the family of भार्गव;
2: M. १२. ५१.
heard it from नारद who got it from ब्रह्मा.
3: Ib. ५३. ७१-2.
वेदव्यास of the २६थ् dva1para;
4: Vi. III. 3. १८.
present at राम's अभिषेक।
5: Ib. IV. 4. १००.
[page३-207+ ३०]
(II)--the father of रोहिणि and पनवी. वा. ९६. १६१.
